2098. Using a Global Variable Alongside Local Input

70

Hard

Problem Statement
Declare a global variable for a fixed base price, then read a local quantity value and compute the total cost directly using the global variable.
Description
Declare a global variable basePrice, initialized outside of main, so it exists for the lifetime of the program and is directly visible inside main (global / program scope) — unlike a local variable, which exists only within the block it is declared in. Inside main, declare a local variable quantity and read its value using scanf. Compute totalCost = basePrice * quantity directly, using the global variable without declaring it again inside main. Print basePrice first (to confirm it is directly visible inside main), then print totalCost.
